title: Smoky Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with smoky chicken, fluffy rice, and a hint of Brazilian spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Brazilian stir-fry sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the smoky chicken stir fry over fluffy rice.
